title: Genesys Dice Forge
description: Dedicated native-WebGL 3D narrative dice module for Genesys. Zero-config automatic Genesys roll capture, rendered-chat fallback, integrated chat-toolbar launcher, three randomized physical roll profiles, natural physics landing with authoritative face remap, deterministic 52-face visual QA cycler, premium physical dice, standalone roll simulator and adaptive audio. Release candidate for Foundry VTT 13.351; Version 14 compatibility is declared but not yet runtime-verified.
